target: Mac-Gray Corporation (laundry facilities management contractor, Waltham, MA; NYSE-listed)
acquirer: CSC ServiceWorks, Inc., acting through Spin Holdco Inc. (Parent) and CSC Fenway, Inc. (Merger Subsidiary), guaranteed by CSC and CSC ServiceWorks Holdings, Inc.; CSC is a Pamplona portfolio company and Pamplona Capital Partners III, L.P. commits the equity (bid as "CSC/Pamplona")
acquirer_type: Strategic (sponsor-owned operating company; financing committed by its sponsor Pamplona)
agreed_price: $21.25 per share in cash; no financing condition; Pamplona commitment of $594 million
earlier_approaches: The 2011-2012 Discussions (winter 2011 into 2012): Mac-Gray considered acquiring CSC, engaging BofA on 10/23/2012; CSC instead ran its own sale and was bought by Pamplona in May 2013 (p. 27). This was a target-as-buyer effort, not a sale of Mac-Gray. Undated strategic discussions "from time to time" with CSC and other industry participants are also mentioned.
currency_units: US dollars per Mac-Gray share. Party B 09/18 bid adds options valued by Party B at $2.50 per share (recorded as CVR/earnout, not in price).
auction_screen: Met (process 1): 20 parties (Party A, CSC/Pamplona, Party B, Party C and 16 unnamed financial parties)
